scope: read-only reconciliation of accepted fixed-100MHz A and AB profiles
interpretation: Exclusive buckets identify observed blocked retirement positions; deltas sum to the measured cycle difference, not independently removable stalls.
Per-PC head waits have broader scope than the exclusive partition and must not be added to it.
Overlapping entry-cycle counters do not measure elapsed CPU cycles. No causal latency, scheduling fix or speedup is inferred.
